answer: Superlinear stake rewards: each epoch an agent's payout grows with the square of its bonded stake. Splitting one stake across a thousand fake accounts then earns about a thousandth of what one account holding it would, so a sybil farm is just an echo of one wallet that pays itself less. The kernel of the idea: identities are free, but fragmented capital is penalized. An attacker wanting a thousand loud voices must bond full stake for each, like building a fortress on every mesa.
